nativeValidation.setup: Run in Bash from a clean APFS checkout at the listed revision. Keep TMPDIR and the unpacked test image on the same APFS volume. Copy the supplied arm64 Linux guest archive into .t3-tmp/darwin-disk after creating that directory and before the checksum command. Native Apple clang, the macOS SDK and Go are required. Ad-hoc codesigning needs no administrator access.
commands: D="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.t3-tmp/darwin-disk"; mkdir -p "$D/tmp" "$D/image"; export TMPDIR="$D/tmp" COPYFILE_DISABLE=1
expectedResults: Go vet and the cgo test build succeed, and codesign verifies the entitled test binary.

The APFS replacement fixture returns ErrUnsupported with required 2147483648 and requested 1073741824 bytes. Growth is never called, the sandbox directory and tracked VM are absent, and the replacement rootfs survives.

The existing Linux early-precheck fixture preserves the directory marker, reports FAILED_PRECONDITION and records FAILED / CREATE_FAILED through the manager. The rejected create leaves no sandbox directory or active VM.

The entitled Virtualization.framework run boots two disposable Linux guests. The 2 GiB and 3 GiB cases each report matching prepared file and guest device bytes (2147483648 and 3221225472) and preserve the source. All selected tests report PASS without SKIP.
limits: The Linux worker could not compile or run the Darwin cgo implementation. These commands remain pending on m3-16.
macOS guest boot tests need a bootable macOS guest image. That image and an IPSW are unavailable and unnecessary for this Linux-guest-only change.
